pages.text: The $(l)Shaving Horse$() is where woodworking begins. Sit at it with a $(item)Drawknife$() in hand and strip a log into a $(l)Rough Limb$(): the raw form of a bow arm.$(br2)Each wood type shaves into its own limb, and that choice decides the weapon's draw speed and damage down the line.
Craft a Shaving Horse to set up your workshop.
A Rough Limb still needs to be made $(l)pliable$() before it can bend into a bow. That happens next, at the $(l)Steam Box$().
